# Ink Blog

> Minimalist bilingual blog template built with Astro 6, React 19, and Tailwind CSS 4.

Ink Blog is an open-source static blog starter with English/Chinese i18n, dark mode, Pagefind full-text search, Mermaid diagrams, KaTeX math, Giscus comments, RSS feeds, JSON-LD structured data, sitemap, and SEO-ready meta tags. Deploy to Vercel, Netlify, or any static host with zero backend.

## Documentation

- [README](https://github.com/OldJii/ink-blog/blob/main/README.md): Full documentation
- [Live demo](https://folay.top): Example deployment

## Features

- Bilingual (en/zh), dark mode, Pagefind search, Mermaid, KaTeX, Giscus, RSS
- JSON-LD, sitemap, robots.txt, Open Graph, Twitter cards
- Reading time, TOC, image lightbox, Astro Fonts (Inter, Noto Sans SC, JetBrains Mono)

## Quick start

```bash
git clone https://github.com/OldJii/ink-blog.git my-blog
cd my-blog && npm install && npm run dev
```

## Common questions

- **What is Ink Blog?** A free Astro blog template for developers who want a fast, SEO-friendly bilingual site.
- **Does it support Chinese?** Yes — separate content folders for en and zh with i18n UI strings.
- **How to deploy?** Push to GitHub and import in Vercel, or upload `dist/` to any static host.
- **License**: MIT
